subject: Mac compiled Stan models causing download errors

messages.author: 944a94c45996805c
messages.subject: Mac compiled Stan models causing download errors
parts:
Hello,

I've been building an R package that uses Stan and recently tried to get a coworker to install the package.  We attempted doing an installation directly from github using devtools::install_github("ColtoCaro/compMS"). 

On a Windows machine this fails with the following message.

The downloaded binary packages are in

            C:\Users\thom100\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpUz9s4Z\downloaded_packages

"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-33~1.3/bin/x64/R" --no-site-file --no-environ --no-save --no-restore  \

  --quiet CMD INSTALL  \

  "C:/Users/thom100/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpUz9s4Z/devtoolsac077767bcd/ColtoCaro-compMS-23a46cd"  \

  --library="C:/Users/thom100/Documents/R/win-library/3.3" --install-tests 

 

* installing *source* package 'compMS' ...

** libs

C:\Rtools\mingw_64\bin\nm.exe: Modules.o: File format not recognized

c:/Rtools/mingw_64/bin/g++ -shared -s -static-libgcc -o compMS.dll tmp.def Modules.o -Ld:/Compiler/gcc-4.9.3/local330/lib/x64 -Ld:/Compiler/gcc-4.9.3/local330/lib -LC:/PROGRA~1/R/R-33~1.3/bin/x64 -lR

Modules.o: file not recognized: File format not recognized

collect2.exe: error: ld returned 1 exit status

no DLL was created

ERROR: compilation failed for package 'compMS'

* removing 'C:/Users/thom100/Documents/R/win-library/3.3/compMS'

Error: Command failed (1)


On a Linux OS we get past the compiler issue but run into an error when it encounters Mac compiled objects.

Am I doing something fundamentally wrong?

Thanks,

Jonathon

messages.author: 944a94c45996805c
messages.subject: Re: Mac compiled Stan models causing download errors
parts:
Update.  The install now works on a Linux machine.  

Adding 
*.o
*.so
to the gitignore file was sufficient to keep the models I'd been playing with from causing problem with a download.  I still have no idea how to make this work on Windows...

Jonathon

messages.author: 944a94c45996805c
messages.subject: Re: Mac compiled Stan models causing download errors
parts:
It turns out that the user who was trying to download my package did not have Rstan correctly installed.  After going through the instructions on this page https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/Installing-RStan-on-Windows and then downloading the package, everything worked.  

Should I explain to Windows users that these instructions https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/Installing-RStan-on-Windows need to be carefully followed prior to attempting an install of my package?

Thanks,

Jonathon

It turns out that the user who was trying to download my package did not have Rstan correctly installed.  After going through the instructions on this page https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/Installing-RStan-on-Windows and then downloading the package, everything worked.  

Should I explain to Windows users that these instructions https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/Installing-RStan-on-Windows need to be carefully followed prior to attempting an install of my package?
Yes, although if your package were on CRAN and listed rstan in Imports, then those instructions wouldn't be necessary.
